"""The harness family's data contract: vocabularies, options, messages and errors."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from enum import StrEnum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Final, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel

from vvaharness.util.tokens import TokenUsage

if TYPE_CHECKING:

#: Logical tool name (profile YAML) to native DeepAgents name; never rebuilt, middleware has it.
LOGICAL_TO_NATIVE: Final[Mapping[str, str]] = {
    "Read": "read_file",
    "Grep": "grep",
    "Glob": "glob",
    "Edit": "edit_file",
    "Write": "write_file",
}

#: Logical tools that only read.
READ_TOOLS: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"Read", "Grep", "Glob"})

#: Logical tools that orchestrate rather than touch the filesystem.
ORCHESTRATION_TOOLS: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"Agent", "Task", "TodoWrite", "Skill"})

#: Logical tools that mutate, denied in a read-only session.
MUTATING_TOOLS: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"Bash", "Edit", "NotebookEdit", "Write"})

#: Logical tools a read-only session may call without a path check; Write is gated per-path instead.
READ_ONLY_TOOLS: Final[frozenset[str]] = READ_TOOLS | ORCHESTRATION_TOOLS

#: Logical mutating tools denied outright; derived so a new tool above can't desync the two.
UNCONDITIONALLY_DENIED_TOOLS: Final[frozenset[str]] = MUTATING_TOOLS - {"Write", "Bash"}

#: Native names of the mutating tools. Derived, so adding a tool above cannot desync the two.
NATIVE_WRITE_TOOLS: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
    LOGICAL_TO_NATIVE[name] for name in MUTATING_TOOLS if name in LOGICAL_TO_NATIVE
)

#: Native tools whose results carry file content; ``glob``/``ls`` return only paths.
NATIVE_CONTENT_TOOLS: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"read_file", "grep"})

#: Not grantable via LOGICAL_TO_NATIVE -- a refused ls wastes turns; granted with reads only
NATIVE_IMPLIED_READS: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset({"ls"})

#: Shell native, deliberately NOT in LOGICAL_TO_NATIVE (would become a write tool); allow_shell only
NATIVE_SHELL_TOOL: Final = "execute"

#: Legacy custom dispatch tool. Native subagents are used instead, so it is never granted.
LEGACY_AGENT_TOOL: Final = "Agent"

#: Prefix marking a tool supplied by an MCP server, which the permission gate allows.
MCP_TOOL_PREFIX: Final = "mcp__"


class EffortLevel(StrEnum):
    """Reasoning-effort tier accepted by the agent backend."""

    LOW = "low"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    HIGH = "high"
    XHIGH = "xhigh"
    MAX = "max"

    @classmethod
    def parse(cls, value: str | None) -> EffortLevel | None:
        """Map a string to an effort tier, returning None when absent or invalid."""
        try:
            return cls(value)
        except ValueError:
            return None


class SettingSource(StrEnum):
    """Origin of a settings layer the agent backend may load."""

    USER = "user"
    PROJECT = "project"
    LOCAL = "local"


class Provider(StrEnum):
    """Which vendor's chat model a role resolves to. Anthropic, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint."""

    ANTHROPIC = "anthropic"
    OPENAI = "openai"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ToolPolicy:
    """Declarative allowed/disallowed tool list for a harness session."""

    allowed_tools: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    disallowed_tools: tuple[str, ...] = ()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FactToolSpec:
    """One deterministic fact tool, described without reference to any tool framework."""
    # Beside tool_builder: claude/ imports no langchain; fn takes kwargs, returns JSON, in-process

    name: str
    description: str
    #: JSON Schema for the arguments, as ``claude_agent_sdk.tool()`` accepts directly.
    input_schema: dict[str, Any]
    fn: Callable[..., Any]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SubagentDefinition:
    """SDK-insulated subagent definition for a named agent in a streaming session."""

    name: str
    description: str
    prompt: str
    tools: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
    disallowed_tools: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
    model: str | None = None
    skills: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
    response_model: type | None = None
    #: deepagents only: model-call cap, the last call keeping only the outcome; None/<=0 = none.
    max_model_calls: int | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PermissionDecision:
    """Result of a single permission evaluation: allow/deny with an optional reason."""

    allow: bool
    reason: str = ""
    interrupt: bool = False


# Builds a session's concrete tool objects; typed loosely so the contract skips SDK tool types.
ToolBuilder = Callable[..., list[Any]]


def compose_tool_builders(*builders: ToolBuilder | None) -> ToolBuilder:
    """Union multiple ``ToolBuilder``s into one — ``tool_builder`` is a single field."""
    live = [b for b in builders if b is not None]

    def _build(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> list[Any]:
        out: list[Any] = []
        for b in live:
            out.extend(b(*args, **kwargs) or [])
        return out

    return _build


#: Cosmetic name for the compiled agent graph when a consumer does not name it.
DEFAULT_GRAPH_NAME: Final = "agent"


@dataclass
class SessionOptions:
    """What every harness invocation needs, whichever shape it takes."""

    model: str
    cwd: Path
    env: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    # deepagents backend selector: "openai" | "anthropic"; None => infer from name.
    model_provider: str | None = None
    effort: str | None = None
    #: Ask for the reasoning in the prompt instead of native reasoning (deepagents only; a no-op
    #: where model_building.reasons_in_prompt is False). See model_building.REASON_IN_PROMPT.
    think_in_prompt: bool = False
    #: OpenAI-branch transport OVERRIDE (config-pinned); None resolves: learned, then Responses.
    use_responses_api: bool | None = None
    system_prompt: str | None = None
    tool_policy: ToolPolicy | None = None
    cli_path: str | None = None  # absolute path to the claude executable (pin)
    #: Pydantic model *class* for structured output (None = none).
    response_model: type | None = None
    #: Builds the session's tools (None = the backend's generic readers).
    tool_builder: ToolBuilder | None = None
    #: Extra tool names granted to subagents beyond the policy.
    fact_tools: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    #: Backend-neutral fact tools: Claude publishes them over MCP, deepagents IGNORES them
    fact_tool_specs: tuple[FactToolSpec, ...] = ()
    #: When False, write/edit tools are denied.
    allow_writes: bool = False
    #: Paths writes may target when allow_writes is True.
    writable_paths: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    #: Directory of agent skill packages to load (None = none).
    skill_root: Path | None = None
    graph_name: str = DEFAULT_GRAPH_NAME
    #: Per-call output cap; None inherits 64k on Anthropic, uncapped on OpenAI; detection only
    max_output_tokens: int | None = None
    #: models.<role>.max_tokens; bounds CapOutputTokens' ONE doubled-budget retry below 64k
    output_cap: int | None = None
    #: Whether BlockMarkerPromptCaching places markers; wired from config sdk.cache_markers
    cache_markers: bool = True
    #: Caller-specific middleware applied to the graph.
    parent_middleware: tuple[AgentMiddleware, ...] = ()
    #: Force the outcome tool only on the call that ends the session; False forces every call.
    force_verdict_only: bool = False


@dataclass
class OneShotOptions(SessionOptions):
    """Options for a parser-only single-turn invocation."""

    max_turns: int = 15
    output_schema: Mapping[str, object] | None = None
    #: Cacheable leading user-turn CONTENT (never a hint); folded verbatim where no marker seam
    cache_prefix: str | None = None


@dataclass
class StreamingOptions(SessionOptions):
    """Options for a full streaming session."""

    max_turns: int | None = None
    max_budget_usd: float | None = None
    #: Whole-session wall clock, seconds. None (the default) is unbounded, so any
    #: caller that never sets this keeps its current, unbounded behavior.
    timeout: float | None = None
    #: Grant the shell native and select an executing backend. Off by default.
    allow_shell: bool = False
    setting_sources: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
    permissions: PermissionsPolicy | None = None
    agents: dict[str, SubagentDefinition] = field(default_factory=dict)
    output_schema: dict[str, object] | None = None
    #: NATIVE names PermitTools admits at wrap_tool_call (fail closed); None installs NO gate
    permitted_tool_calls: frozenset[str] | None = None
    #: Leading user-turn CONTENT in its own marked block -- the 4th and LAST Anthropic breakpoint
    cache_prefix: str | None = None
    #: Caller-pinned session identity. Becomes the LangGraph thread_id AND the reported
    #: session_id, and keys the compiled-graph cache -- which is what makes resume_streaming
    #: continue THE SAME conversation instead of re-sending a copy of it. "" means a fresh
    #: random thread, unresumable, which is the historical behaviour.
    session_id: str = ""


@dataclass
class HarnessSessionInit:
    """Session-init event carrying the session ID and raw SDK payload."""

    kind: Literal["session_init"] = "session_init"
    session_id: str = ""
    raw: dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)


# Optional provenance tags for backends streaming nested subagents; other backends leave both None.
@dataclass
class HarnessAssistantText:
    """A streamed text block emitted by the assistant."""

    kind: Literal["assistant_text"] = "assistant_text"
    text: str = ""
    agent: str | None = None
    namespace: tuple[str, ...] | None = None


@dataclass
class HarnessToolUse:
    """A tool-invocation request emitted by the assistant."""

    kind: Literal["tool_use"] = "tool_use"
    tool_id: str = ""
    name: str = ""
    input: dict[str, object] = field(default_factory=dict)
    agent: str | None = None
    namespace: tuple[str, ...] | None = None


@dataclass
class HarnessToolResult:
    """The result returned by a tool after a HarnessToolUse."""

    kind: Literal["tool_result"] = "tool_result"
    is_error: bool = False
    content: object = None
    agent: str | None = None
    namespace: tuple[str, ...] | None = None


@dataclass
class HarnessResult:
    """Terminal message marking the end of a streaming session."""
    # Deliberately NOT frozen: ClaudeHarness sets `state` after yielding, carrying persona reports

    kind: Literal["result"] = "result"
    subtype: str = ""
    is_error: bool = False
    session_id: str | None = None
    result_text: str | None = None
    structured: BaseModel | None = None
    # The only channel separating schema-validation exhaustion from a fallback retracting output.
    errors: list[str] | None = None
    # Cumulative session token usage/cost from the SDK ResultMessage.
    usage: TokenUsage | None = None
    total_cost_usd: float | None = None
    # Backend-specific terminal state; DeepAgents uses it for host-side subagent report extraction.
    state: object = None
    #: Final turn clipped by its output budget; blind backends leave False -- only narrows trust
    truncated: bool = False
    #: An assistant turn was refused and no valid structured answer followed; backends that
    #: cannot see refusals leave False. *refusal_category* is the provider's label, if any.
    refused: bool = False
    refusal_category: str | None = None


HarnessMessage = (
    HarnessSessionInit
    | HarnessAssistantText
    | HarnessToolUse
    | HarnessToolResult
    | HarnessResult
)


@dataclass
class OneShotResult:
    """Result of a single-turn parser-only invocation."""

    is_error: bool = False
    subtype: str = ""
    result_text: str | None = None
    structured: BaseModel | None = None
    # Cumulative session token usage/cost from the SDK ResultMessage.
    usage: TokenUsage | None = None
    total_cost_usd: float | None = None
    #: See ``HarnessResult.truncated``.
    truncated: bool = False
    #: See ``HarnessResult.refused``.
    refused: bool = False
    refusal_category: str | None = None


class HarnessError(Exception):
    """Base class for all harness-level failures."""


class SessionNotResumableError(HarnessError):
    """A stopped session cannot be resumed.

    Covers every cause: never pinned, released, capability-gated, still running past the
    exit grace, or a resume subprocess that failed, errored, or returned no text.
    """


class HarnessCLINotFoundError(HarnessError):
    """Underlying CLI binary is missing. Fatal for the whole batch."""


class HarnessConnectionError(HarnessError):
    """Connection to the underlying agent runtime failed."""


class HarnessProcessError(HarnessError):
    """Agent process exited abnormally. Carries exit_code and stderr tail."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        exit_code: int | None = None,
        stderr: str | None = None,
        *,
        recursion_limited: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        """Store message, exit_code, stderr tail, and the loop-budget subtype flag."""
        super().__init__(message)
        self.exit_code = exit_code
        self.stderr = stderr
        #: Recursion-limit death -> consumer may force-finalize; typed so a rename breaks loudly
        self.recursion_limited = recursion_limited


class HarnessJSONDecodeError(HarnessError):
    """JSON decode failure on agent output."""


class HarnessMessageParseError(HarnessError):
    """Message parsing failed mid-stream."""

  Credential options (pick the one that matches your profile):
    CLI backend (default):   run `claude /login`  or export CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=<fresh-token>

    HTTPS_PROXY          — HTTPS proxy               (e.g. http://proxy:3128)

class AuthenticationError(HarnessError):
    """Authentication with the LLM provider failed (VVAH-E001)."""

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E001"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        status_code: int | None = None,
        backend: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        """Build the operator-facing message, appending the credential remediation block."""
        full = (
            f"[{self.error_code}] Authentication failed"
            + (f" (HTTP {status_code})" if status_code else "")
            + (f" [{backend}]" if backend else "")
            + f": {message}\n"
            + _AUTH_REMEDIATION
        )
        super().__init__(full)
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.backend = backend


class ProxyError(HarnessConnectionError):
    """Proxy / TLS / network configuration error (VVAH-E002); raised without retry."""

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E002"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        status_code: int | None = None,
        backend: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        """Build the operator-facing message, appending the proxy/TLS remediation block."""
        full = (
            f"[{self.error_code}] Proxy/network error"
            + (f" (HTTP {status_code})" if status_code else "")
            + (f" [{backend}]" if backend else "")
            + f": {message}\n"
            + _PROXY_REMEDIATION
        )
        super().__init__(full)
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.backend = backend


class DegenerateResponseError(HarnessError):
    """LLM returned 200 OK but the content is degenerate (VVAH-E003)."""

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E003"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        stage: str = "",
        response_len: int = 0,
        threshold: int = 0,
        consecutive: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        """Build the message; a single short response is a warning, so only repeats reach here."""
        detail = (
            (f" | stage={stage}" if stage else "")
            + (f" | len={response_len} (threshold={threshold})" if threshold else "")
            + (f" | consecutive={consecutive}" if consecutive else "")
        )
        full = f"[{self.error_code}] Degenerate LLM response{detail}: {message}"
        super().__init__(full)
        self.stage = stage
        self.response_len = response_len
        self.threshold = threshold
        self.consecutive = consecutive


class OversizePromptError(HarnessError):
    """Prompt exceeds the deepagents route's context ceiling (VVAH-E004)."""
    # Raised BEFORE dispatch (never a silent in-flight mutation); NOT a halt error, scan continues

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E004"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        stage: str = "",
        estimated_tokens: int = 0,
        limit: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        """Build the operator-facing message with the measured size and ceiling."""
        detail = (
            (f" | stage={stage}" if stage else "")
            + (f" | estimated_tokens={estimated_tokens} (limit={limit})" if limit else "")
        )
        full = f"[{self.error_code}] Prompt too large for the deepagents route{detail}: {message}"
        super().__init__(full)
        self.stage = stage
        self.estimated_tokens = estimated_tokens
        self.limit = limit


#: Truncation below this fraction of `requested` = gateway cap/hidden reasoning, not long output
TRUNCATED_BELOW_BUDGET_RATIO: Final = 0.5


def truncated_below_budget(produced: int | None, requested: int) -> bool:
    """True when *produced* output tokens are under half of *requested*."""
    # produced=None is "unknown" (no usage reported), not "below budget", so it never qualifies
    return (produced is not None and requested > 0
            and produced < requested * TRUNCATED_BELOW_BUDGET_RATIO)


class TruncatedResponseError(HarnessError):
    """LLM reply cut off by its output-token budget despite one retry (VVAH-E005); non-halt."""

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E005"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        stage: str = "",
        requested: int = 0,
        retried: int = 0,
        produced: int | None = None,
        reasoning_tokens: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Build the operator-facing message with the budgets that truncated."""
        detail = (
            (f" | stage={stage}" if stage else "")
            + (f" | requested={requested}" if requested else "")
            + (f" | retried_at={retried}" if retried else "")
            + (f" | produced={produced}" if produced is not None else "")
            + (f" | reasoning_tokens={reasoning_tokens}"
               if reasoning_tokens is not None else "")
        )
        hint = ""
        if truncated_below_budget(produced, requested):
            hint = (
                f" — provider stopped at {produced} output tokens against a "
                f"{requested} budget: a gateway-side cap or reasoning "
                f"consumption, not genuinely long output; set "
                f"models.<role>.max_tokens: {produced} or lower step*.effort"
            )
        full = f"[{self.error_code}] Truncated LLM response{detail}: {message}{hint}"
        super().__init__(full)
        self.stage = stage
        self.requested = requested
        self.retried = retried
        self.produced = produced
        self.reasoning_tokens = reasoning_tokens


_TOOL_STATE_REMEDIATION = """\
  The endpoint rejected a replayed tool call as missing its per-call state. On Chat
  Completions, via: deepagents sends back every top-level field of a tool call outside
  the standard schema on the same call. The state can be missing because the endpoint
  did not return it, returned it somewhere other than a top-level field of the tool
  call, or the call went over the Responses API. Any via: deepagents session that makes
  one tool call and then continues can hit it, on the session's second tool-using turn,
  whatever the role is named.

  Run `vvaharness doctor --config <profile>` and follow
  docs/errors.md#vvah-e006-tool-call-state-not-round-tripped. That section lists each
  fix and the roles it covers.

  Last resort only, and it is a degradation, not a fix: a tool-less session
  on via: deepagents avoids this failure, but it also loses ALL graph-tool
  evidence for that session. This codebase treats graph-tool evidence as
  first-class (a verdict rests on code-graph evidence, not prose alone), so
  disabling tools/planning to sidestep this is explicitly the wrong kind of
  fix — use it only if via: openai is genuinely unavailable, and label the
  run as running with degraded evidence."""


class ToolStateNotRoundTrippedError(HarnessError):
    """A provider rejected a replayed tool call for missing opaque state (VVAH-E006)."""
    # Non-halt, deterministic: the endpoint rejects a replay as missing its per-call state

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E006"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        stage: str = "",
        model_id: str = "",
    ) -> None:
        """Build the operator-facing message naming the model/stage, plus the fix."""
        detail = (
            (f" | model={model_id}" if model_id else "")
            + (f" | stage={stage}" if stage else "")
        )
        full = (
            f"[{self.error_code}] Tool-call state not round-tripped{detail}: "
            f"{message}\n" + _TOOL_STATE_REMEDIATION
        )
        super().__init__(full)
        self.stage = stage
        self.model_id = model_id


class ModelCallBudgetExhaustedError(HarnessError):
    """A unit's model-call budget ran out before it reached a verdict (VVAH-E007)."""
    # Opt-in via ModelCallBudget(raise_when_exhausted): S4 only; NOT halt, never changes exit code

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E007"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        stage: str = "",
        limit: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        """Build the operator-facing message naming the unit/stage and the spent budget."""
        detail = (
            (f" | stage={stage}" if stage else "")
            + (f" | limit={limit}" if limit else "")
        )
        full = f"[{self.error_code}] Model-call budget exhausted{detail}: {message}"
        super().__init__(full)
        self.stage = stage
        self.limit = limit


class CallTimeoutError(HarnessError, TimeoutError):
    """A model call exceeded its effort-scaled wall-clock budget (VVAH-E008); non-halt."""
    # TimeoutError base is load-bearing: is_timeout_failure() and every `except TimeoutError`
    # pass it through unchanged with no change to either.

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E008"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        stage: str = "",
        route: str = "",
        budget_s: float | None = None,
        effort: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Build the operator-facing message naming the stage/route/budget/effort that timed out."""
        budget = f"{budget_s:g}s" if budget_s is not None else "unbounded"
        detail = (
            (f" | stage={stage}" if stage else "")
            + (f" | route={route}" if route else "")
            + f" | budget={budget}"
            + (f" | effort={effort}" if effort else "")
        )
        full = (
            f"[{self.error_code}] Call timed out{detail}: {message}"
            " — raise the stage's timeout/ceiling knob or lower its effort"
        )
        super().__init__(full)
        self.stage = stage
        self.route = route
        self.budget_s = budget_s
        self.effort = effort


class RepeatedToolCallError(HarnessError):
    """A session repeated one identical tool call past the repeat guard (VVAH-E009); non-halt."""

    error_code: str = "VVAH-E009"

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        stage: str = "",
        route: str = "",
        tool_name: str = "",
        repeats: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        """Build the operator-facing message naming the stage/route/tool/repeat count."""
        detail = (
            (f" | stage={stage}" if stage else "")
            + (f" | route={route}" if route else "")
            + (f" | tool={tool_name}" if tool_name else "")
            + (f" | repeats={repeats}" if repeats else "")
        )
        full = (
            f"[{self.error_code}] Repeated identical tool call{detail}: {message}"
            " — the session is not converging; aborting rather than exhausting the timeout"
        )
        super().__init__(full)
        self.stage = stage
        self.route = route
        self.tool_name = tool_name
        self.repeats = repeats


# Next code VVAH-E010 (imbalance gets none); E010+ also extends docs/errors.md


def is_halt_error(exc: BaseException) -> bool:
    """True for VVAH-E001/E002, which must abort the scan immediately."""
    # Must live HERE: a copied predicate + copied hierarchy makes every halt guard a silent no-op
    return isinstance(exc, (AuthenticationError, ProxyError))


def is_token_error(exc: BaseException) -> bool:
    """True when the error is the normalized provider token failure."""
    return isinstance(exc, AuthenticationError)

    "DEFAULT_GRAPH_NAME",
    "LEGACY_AGENT_TOOL",
    "LOGICAL_TO_NATIVE",
    "MCP_TOOL_PREFIX",
